migration_and_rollback.projection_note: Rollback is the two commits recorded by this packet. No new branch, graph authority, persistence surface, backend, registry, helper layer, or public API was introduced.

title: Align strict Boolean cross-plane hyperedge refusal with canonical Fourfold authority

masterplan.active_delivery_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

result.summary: The strict public Boolean compatibility projector now fails closed when a matching ForestHyperedge spans both selected Fourfold endpoint planes. This removes a lossy-success path where a higher-arity cross-plane relation could previously be ignored and returned as an empty binary block while the canonical compiler, legacy Fourfold adapter, and projection verifier already treated the same shape as unrepresentable.

finding.problem: boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold handled verified cross-plane bindings and raw cross-plane ForestEdge consistency but did not inspect cross-plane ForestHyperedge evidence. A matching higher-arity relation could therefore disappear into sparse zeroes even though the binary TypedRelationBlock representation cannot preserve its semantics.
existing_authority: fourfold_from_knowledge_forest refuses a cross-plane hyperedge because it cannot be represented as pairwise verified bindings without losing semantics.
compile_relation_blocks already refuses a conflicting cross-plane ForestHyperedge instead of silently omitting it.
The Fourfold/Tensor contract requires fail-closed treatment of hyperedges rather than invented pairwise semantics.
finding.gardener_decision: Repair the existing compatibility projector in place and pin parity with the canonical compiler. Do not add a shared third projector/helper or another relation schema.

implementation.summary: For a cross-plane RelationSignature, the strict Boolean adapter now scans only matching ForestHyperedge records and refuses when members intersect both selected endpoint axes. Verified Fourfold bindings remain the only cross-plane binary fact source; no hyperedge is flattened into invented pairs.
preserved_contracts: Verified Fourfold bindings remain the sole cross-plane fact authority.
Raw directed cross-plane ForestEdge records remain consistency/admission inputs only.
Same-plane retention, empty-retention pruning, provenance revision checks, complete endpoint-plane checks, and indexed block construction remain unchanged.
No owner approval, promotion receipt, effect, or gate transition is created by projection.

coverage: A manually constructed code-to-knowledge ForestHyperedge with matching documents relation is rejected by boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold.
The same bounded fixture is rejected by compile_relation_blocks, pinning compatibility/canonical refusal parity.
Existing same-plane retention, verified cross-plane edge, and indexed-construction regressions remain in the same owner.
